title: Total Sales per Product
scenario: Calculate the total quantity sold for each product. Output 'product_name' and the sum of 'quantity'.
tableSchema: Sales (product_id INT, quantity INT), Products (id INT, product_name VARCHAR)
hint: Join tables and group by the product name.
correctQuery: SELECT p.product_name, SUM(s.quantity) FROM Sales s JOIN Products p ON s.product_id = p.id GROUP BY p.product_name;
setupSQL: CREATE TABLE Sales (product_id INT, quantity INT); CREATE TABLE Products (id INT, product_name VARCHAR);
